policy_title: Ban foreign supertrawlers from UK waters
stated: Reform UK will ban foreign supertrawlers from UK waters, extend the ban on pair trawling for bass beyond the South East and 12-mile territorial waters, and ban Dutch vessels from electric pulse fishing in Britain's 200 mile EEZ.

source.quote: Ban Foreign Supertrawlers from UK Waters Extend the ban on pair trawling for bass beyond the South East and 12-mile territorial waters. Ban Dutch vessels from electric pulse fishing in Britain’s 200 mile EEZ.

bearing_set.reason: Supertrawlers and electric pulse fishing cause documented seabed destruction, bycatch, and depletion of fish stocks; banning them from UK waters would plausibly improve marine ecosystem health, a core O6 indicator.

Excluding foreign supertrawlers from UK waters reduces direct competition for UK fishing vessel operators and crews, with a plausible non-negligible effect on livelihoods and employment quality in the domestic fishing industry.

membership_note: Two genuine bearings: environmental (O6) is the primary target; labour-market benefit to UK fishers (O4) is a concrete secondary effect. Aggregate prosperity (O13) is not materially moved — fishing is under 0.1% of UK GDP. Consumer fish-price effects on O2 are too uncertain and indirect to clear the non-negligible bar.
